clean.tl: The Swedish Argus No 1. No one can deny that such writings are indeed beneficial, that, in a pleasant and amusing manner, administer learning and science. So the ancients have instructed the people on virtue through entertaining poems, delightful conversations and diverting tales, and imparted grave lessons of morality in an almost jocular manner. In more recent times, and even today, we still find writings of this kind, useful and cherished, published in wise nations.’ (Argus, 1730s; from FTB)
